short: Turn your own notes into a fun quiz that helps you remember – free & private.
full:
StudyNight turns your own study material into a game.

Add lecture slides, notes, a PDF, a Word file or a photo of your notebook – or just paste some text. In about half a minute you are playing a quiz built from your material. Every question shows exactly where in your notes it came from, and StudyNight keeps bringing back what you find tricky until your exam.

YOUR NOTES, YOUR QUIZ
• Works with PDF, PowerPoint, Word, text and photos (handwriting is read on a best-effort basis)
• Seven question types: multiple choice, true or false, fill in the blank, flashcards, match pairs, put in order and explain in your own words (typed or spoken)
• Questions about diagrams and charts, plus code and maths support
• Tap the source on any question to see the exact passage from your notes

CHECKED BEFORE YOU SEE THEM
• Every question is checked against your notes – automatically and by a second, independent AI – before it reaches you
• Report a question in one tap and it disappears for good

MAKE IT A GAME
• Quick play, topic practice, boss battles, sudden death, flashcards and timed exam mode with an estimated score
• XP, levels, streaks with streak freezes, combos and 22 badges
• Challenge a friend with a link – no account needed

LEARN IT FOR GOOD
• Spaced repetition brings each question back just before you would forget it
• See your mastery of every topic and focus on the weak ones
• Exam planner: add your exam date and get a daily plan, with calendar reminders
• Ask your notes: get answers only from your own material, with sources

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no cookies
• Your decks and progress stay on your device; back them up or delete everything at any time
• Works offline for anything you have already created

21 LANGUAGES
Use StudyNight in English, Español, Português, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Nederlands, Polski, Türkçe, Русский, Українська, العربية, فارسی, اردو, हिन्दी, বাংলা, Bahasa Indonesia, Tiếng Việt, 日本語, 한국어 or 简体中文 – and make quizzes in almost any language.

AI can make mistakes – always check against your notes. StudyNight is for personal study; only upload material you have the right to use.
